note: Annotations are kept outside the frozen seeds file. Each label names its basis; labels never require a specific restaurant. Labels are evaluation inputs and must never be supplied to production code or the model.

definitions.DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE: Candidate has a supported-source outlet page without name search: a native Tabelog/TableCheck detail ID, or a Google website URL whose path is a Tabelog outlet detail page (https://tabelog.com/<lang?>/<pref>/A\d+/A\d+/\d+/ with any trailing subpage ignored) or a TableCheck shop page (https://www.tablecheck.com/<lang>/<slug> or /shops/<slug>, trailing /reserve... subpaths ignored). Booking-form hosts such as yoyaku.tabelog.com are NOT direct outlet pages.
definitions.IN_RADIUS: distanceObservation.meters <= 1000 in the captured decision context.

acceptableActions.when: The selection contains only observed, in-radius candidates with a supported source path.
Targets missing identity/area/HARD facts of an observed candidate with a supported path.
Uses a materially different supported source or query; preserves every explicit condition.

annotations.basis: After Tabelog returned one in-radius omakase candidate (Sushi Teppen, native detail), checking it is a lawful, useful step for an open-ended AVAILABILITY request. This seed is a non-regression control: a correct change must not make the Agent stop or ask the user here.

acceptableActions.when: At least 3 in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates are checkable in this context (there are 8: Sumi Sushi Shibuya, Sushi Tatsu Shibuya, Shibuya Sushi Jinnan, Sushi kazumasa, Sushi Matsumoto Shibuya, Sushi Inase, Sushi Rizaki, Naminoue shibuya), so every selected candidate must be in-radius and DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE. Selecting a NAME_RESOLUTION candidate is acceptable only when fewer than 3 in-radius DIRECT candidates are checkable.
Targets in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates whose HARD fact (omakase) is not yet verified.

annotations.basis: Recorded action checked the three nearest sushi candidates by distance (189 m, 209 m, 197 m): Sumi Sushi Shibuya (Google website = Tabelog 13293469, DIRECT), Shibuya Sushi Labo (own website, NAME_RESOLUTION) and Sushi-Au (no website, NAME_RESOLUTION). The context offered 8 checkable in-radius DIRECT candidates, e.g. Sushi Tatsu Shibuya 191 m, Shibuya Sushi Jinnan 328 m, Sushi kazumasa 451 m, Sushi Matsumoto Shibuya 632 m (a later-certified witness). The decision context did not expose which candidates had a direct source page, so the Agent ranked by distance alone. Mapping from candidate IDs to source IDs was taken from the frozen run artifact p20-h001-a1.result.json.gz, not from production eligibility labels.

replayGate.rule: P2-2 item 3: at least 2/3 of annotated selection seeds (0134 plus implementer-extracted seeds once the reviewer has annotated them) must produce an ACCEPTABLE action after the availabilityPath change; 0133 must remain ACCEPTABLE.
replayGate.pendingAnnotation: Seeds newly extracted by the implementer stay NOT_EVALUATED until the reviewer annotates them in this file.
